scientific_limitations: Exact only for the binary alphabet and at most three distinct literal 2-binomial-square factors; the upper bound uses a complete and reproducible finite search. No assertion for larger square budgets or alternative repetition equivalences.
title: Exact finite threshold for three distinct 2-binomial squares in binary words
